column1: # Hungarian glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council; nothing here is final, safety rows included.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Hungarian, forms separated by " | ". Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them. Evidence and reasons are in l10n/style/hu.md; the source column names only Hungarian evidence, so a bare claude-only row is Claude's choice.

# Hungarian takes suffixes, and the check matches a form at the start of a word, so roller also finds rollert. Forms are listed only where the stem changes (lámpa, lámpát) or a verb splits (feloldod, oldd fel). Lock and unlock rows list whole forms, never a bare stem, so a word such as lezáratlan cannot pass as Lock.

# Rows D3 retires keep the chosen term's Hungarian until en.tsv drops them. D3's new and renamed rows wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/hu.tsv until D3 merges (scratch/lang/glossary_hold.py restores them). acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo become do-not-translate at D3, so those two rows must go when it merges.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Csúcssebesség and the measured value Maximális sebesség, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
